question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"window."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank is asking for a noun that fits in the context of the sentence.
 
• A **suitcase, toilet, and cupboard** are all objects that could potentially fit in a room, but they don't make sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• A **window**, on the other hand, is an object that is commonly found in a room and fits in the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Window"** means the opening in a building, car, etc. that you can see through and that lets light in. A window usually has glass in it. ((इमारत, कार आदि की) खिड़की)
 
 
• **Example**: *She is peeking from the **window**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

He __opened__ his eyes. Moonlight was shining __through__ the bars on the window. And __someone__ was goggling through the __bars__ at him: a freckle-faced, red-haired, long-nosed someone. Ron Weasley was outside Harry's __window__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (suitcase)** is a type of luggage used for carrying clothes and personal belongings. (बक्‍सा (यात्रा के दौरान कपड़े आदि ले जाने के लिए प्रयुक्त); सूटकेस)
 
• **Option 2 (toilet)** is a fixture used for urination and defecation. ((मल-विसर्जन के पात्र आदि वाला) शौचस्‍थल; शौचगृह, शौचालय)
 
• **Option 4 (cupboard)** is a piece of furniture used for storing items, typically with shelves or drawers. (भोजन, वस्‍त्रों आदि को संभालकर रखने की दरवाज़ोंवाली अलमारी)
